summary: A member at war asks the head of the bloodline for help. The head may send gold, lend the dead of their own lands, or refuse.

title: The head answers
summary: The head of the bloodline has sent help (gold or the dead).

title: The head refuses
summary: The head of the bloodline will not help.

title: A thrall's gift
summary: A living thrall offers their blood to their vampire liege. Drinking deep heals the vampire and leaves the thrall weak; drinking sparingly is kinder. Either way the service counts as the thrall's deed for rank 2.

title: A daylight errand
summary: The thrall runs an errand for their master where a vampire can't go: into a church, a market at noon, a guild hall. Success earns gold and counts as the thrall's deed; failure leaves them suspected or hurt.

title: The Night of Blood
summary: The trial of the Court: on one night the vampire must raise the dead of a graveyard and drown a village in terror, unseen by the witch hunters. A month later: vampsoc.101.

title: The night ends
summary: The bold choice pays more and fails more often. Success passes the trial; failure means waiting five years to try again.

title: Throw off the mask
summary: A hidden von Carstein reveals what they are to their court.

title: The Feud of the Counts
summary: Vlad von Carstein is dead for good. His get turn on one another: for twenty years every Vampire Lord of the Court is a rival of the others, and the Feud flavour (vampsoc.113) offers claims on each other's lands.

title: Vlad is dead
summary: Every Vampire Count and Lord hears that the master is gone. The Lords become rivals of each other.

title: The Feud ends
summary: Twenty years on, the Feud of the Counts is over. Whoever leads the Court now leads it in earnest. sweep).

title: A rival Count
summary: During the Feud, a rival Vampire Lord holds lands you could take. Press a claim, or make a pact against the others. a rival von Carstein ruler.

calls: vampsoc.113; vampsoc.121; vampsoc.122; vampsoc.123; vampsoc.124; vampsoc.125; vampsoc.126
title: von Carstein flavour
summary: Picks one Court of Sylvania flavour event (vampsoc.121 - vampsoc.126, and the Feud, vampsoc.113).

title: A hungry Count
summary: A lesser vampire of the Court covets your lands and has been courting your vassals. Pay him off in Blood, or humble him in public.

title: The restless graveyard
summary: The dead of a village graveyard stir on their own. Bind them to your levies, or let them sleep.

title: The priest who would not drink
summary: A priest at your court has noticed that you never take the sacrament and never stand in the sun. Silence him, or wait.

title: Tribute to Drakenhof
summary: The Master of Court demands tribute from every Count. Pay, or refuse and be remembered for it.

title: A mortal begs the kiss
summary: A mortal noble at your court begs to be made one of the undying. Bind him with the promise, or turn him down.

title: An envoy returns
summary: Your envoy comes home from a mortal court with a treaty, and perhaps the Seal of Drakenhof.

title: Sylvania Reborn
summary: The Master of Court works the great ritual over the land of Sylvania. Two to three years later: vampsoc.131.

title: The land answers
summary: Every county of Sylvania held by the Master or their vassals is bound to the dead, and the Master is bound to the land. For life.

title: A champion's challenge
summary: The Blood Dragon rides out to challenge a famed mortal champion. A win earns Honour (and for a squire, counts as the deed for rank 2); a loss costs Honour and blood.

title: Challenge to the Grand Master
summary: A Blood Dragon Lord challenges the Grand Master before the knights of the Order. The victor leads the Ordo Draconis. Grand Master, saved by vampsoc_challenge_grand_master.

title: Unseated
summary: The Grand Master has lost the challenge and the Order.

title: The code of Abhorash
summary: A knight with no Honour left to lose is stripped of rank and sent back among the squires to earn it again.

calls: vampsoc.171; vampsoc.172; vampsoc.173; vampsoc.174; vampsoc.175; vampsoc.176
title: Blood Dragon flavour
summary: Picks one Ordo Draconis flavour event (vampsoc.171 - vampsoc.176).

title: A squire's oath
summary: A young mortal knight begs to serve the Blood Dragon and one day earn the blood. Training him takes time and gives Honour; turning him away is safe.

title: An insult at court
summary: A mortal knight mocks the Order at a feast. A Blood Dragon cannot let it pass: fight him, or let a lesser knight take the insult for the Order.

title: The red thirst
summary: After a battle the thirst rises. Master it as Abhorash taught, or glut yourself on the dying.

title: A worthy foe falls
summary: Word comes of a great champion slain by the Blood Dragon's hand, or by a knight of their household. The Order honours the deed; there is a small chance of the Dragon Plate of the Order.

title: The tourney at the Blood Keep
summary: The Grand Master summons the knights of the Order to the lists. Attending earns Honour and the Grand Master's regard, at the risk of a wound.

title: The dream of Abhorash
summary: In the day-sleep the Blood Dragon dreams of Abhorash, who mastered the thirst on the peaks of the World's Edge. Patience or fury.

title: The trail of Abhorash
summary: The Grand Master leaves the Blood Keep to find the founder's trail in the World's Edge Mountains. Two to three years later: vampsoc.181.

title: The dragon of the peaks
summary: High in the mountains the Grand Master faces the beast Abhorash himself once fought. Win, and the trail leads on (vampsoc.182); lose, and the quest ends with wounds and shame.

title: Abhorash's peak
summary: The Grand Master reaches the peak where Abhorash conquered the thirst, and there learns his secret. A blessing for life, and every knight of the Order gains Honour.

title: Assisting mortals
summary: A Lahmian Queen helps a mortal ruler at war, with gold or with sellswords under her own banner. The mortal is caught in the web of the Sisterhood (the Tithe of the Houses counts them).

title: Sellswords from a friend
summary: The sellswords paid for by the Lahmian arrive at the mortal's capital and serve until the peace.

title: The Tithe of the Houses
summary: Every Lahmian house and every mortal in the web pays the Queen of Mysteries her due.

calls: vampsoc.221; vampsoc.222; vampsoc.223; vampsoc.224; vampsoc.225; vampsoc.226
title: Lahmian flavour
summary: Picks one Lahmian Sisterhood flavour event (vampsoc.221 - vampsoc.226).

title: A witch hunter asks questions
summary: A witch hunter has heard rumours about the beautiful lady who is never seen by day. Mislead him with Favour, have him killed (risky), or flee the court for a while.

title: A rival Sister
summary: Another Sister has been whispering against you to the Queen. Outwit her, or buy her silence.

title: A letter from the Silver Pinnacle
summary: The Queen of Mysteries asks a service: gold for a bribe in a distant court. Obey for Favour, or ignore her at a cost.

title: An admirer
summary: A mortal admirer begs for the honour of feeding you. Drink, or toy with them for the court's amusement.

title: The masked ball
summary: You host a masked ball, and the princes of the realm dance with you until dawn. Favour, and a small chance of the Cameo of Neferata.

title: The portrait
summary: A courtier has found an old portrait of you, painted sixty years ago, and you have not aged a day. Bribe them, kill them, or let them talk.

title: The Great Web
summary: The Queen of Mysteries sets out to bind the courts of the Old World to the Silver Pinnacle. Three to five years later: vampsoc.231.

title: The web is spun
summary: Every Sister gains Favour and the Queen rules the courts from her bed and her letters. For life.

title: The Magnum Opus
summary: The Necrarch begins the great work of their unlife. Two to four years later: vampsoc.251.

title: The work is done
summary: Learning decides the result. Success passes the trial with a reward by field; failure costs five years.

title: The hunt for a relic of Nagash
summary: A Master Necrarch sends an expedition into the deserts of Nehekhara for a relic of the Great Necromancer. Two to three years later: vampsoc.256.

title: The expedition returns
summary: The relic is found (a seat in the Dark Tower can now be claimed), the Tomb Kings drive the expedition off, or the desert takes it.

title: A Wight King rises
summary: A Master Necrarch binds the spirit of a barrow king back into his bones: a Wight King who serves as a commander (wight_rise_effect). He may bring his tomb blade (wight_tomb_blade_effect).

title: A breakthrough
summary: Every twenty years or so a Necrarch's long labour bears fruit.

calls: vampsoc.260; vampsoc.271; vampsoc.272; vampsoc.273; vampsoc.274; vampsoc.275; vampsoc.276
title: Necrarch flavour
summary: The breakthrough when it is due (vampsoc.260), else one Necrarch flavour event (vampsoc.271 - vampsoc.276).

title: A letter from the Tower
summary: Another Necrarch writes to dispute a point of necromantic theory. Answer at length, or ignore them.

title: The apprentice
summary: Your apprentice has made progress, or a terrible mistake.

title: Grave robbing
summary: Your servants need fresh bodies for your work. Rob your own graveyards, or buy corpses from beyond the border.

title: The tower grows
summary: You add a new floor to your tower: a laboratory, an ossuary, a library.

title: Forgotten notes
summary: In an old chest you find your own notes from three centuries ago, and perhaps a copy of a page of the Liber Mortis.

title: The peasants complain
summary: The peasants say the tower's lights burn all night and their dead do not stay buried. Placate them, or ignore them.

title: The Recipe for Nagash
summary: A Lord of the Dark Tower holding a relic of Nagash begins to reconstruct the Great Necromancer's work. Three to five years later: vampsoc.281.

title: The recipe is complete
summary: The Lord has reconstructed the Recipe for Nagash. A permanent mastery of death, and every Necrarch gains Lore.

title: The ghoul court
summary: The trial of the Strigoi: gather a court of ghouls, the cannibal wretches who live among the graves. One to two years later: vampsoc.301.

title: The court gathers
summary: The starving poor make a large court that is hard to hold; the graveyard-eaters make a small one that holds. Success passes the trial.

title: The curse of Ushoran
summary: A Strigoi who has gone hungry loses control and becomes the beast.

calls: vampsoc.310; vampsoc.321; vampsoc.322; vampsoc.323; vampsoc.324; vampsoc.325; vampsoc.326
title: Strigoi flavour
summary: A hungry Strigoi may fall into frenzy (vampsoc.310); otherwise one Strigoi flavour event (vampsoc.321 - vampsoc.326).

title: Scorned by the blood
summary: A vampire of another bloodline has called the Strigoi beasts and grave-eaters before witnesses. Swallow it, or answer in blood.

title: The caravan comes
summary: A Strigany caravan arrives with news, stolen goods and a cart of volunteers for the Strigoi's table.

title: The crypt feast
summary: The ghouls have dug up a fresh graveyard. Join the feast, or keep your dignity.

title: The dream of Strygos
summary: In the day-sleep you walk the marble halls of Strygos before it fell, and Ushoran speaks to you.

title: Digging in the ruins
summary: Your servants dig in the ruins of a Strygan city. Old gold, and perhaps the Bone Crown of Strygos.

title: Hunters on the trail
summary: Vampire hunters have tracked you to your lair. Fight them, or move on.

title: Strygos Reborn
summary: The Heir of Ushoran calls the scattered Strigoi to rebuild the court of Strygos. Three to four years later: vampsoc.331.

title: The court of Ushoran
summary: Strygos lives again in its king. For life, and every Strigoi gains Hunger.

title: The Scribe's Examination
summary: A Crystal Mandarin sits the examination of the Coil, a cruel mirror of the Imperial examinations: three days of questions put by the Sage's serpents.

title: Shedding the skin
summary: The Jade vampire coils in the dark of the crystal chamber and sheds the old skin, and the jade decay with it.

title: The Serpent's Coils
summary: The Serpent Sage winds a mortal ruler in the coils of the Jade Court: tribute now, and a lasting fascination.

calls: vampsoc.371; vampsoc.372; vampsoc.373; vampsoc.374; vampsoc.375; vampsoc.376
title: Jade flavour
summary: Picks one Jade Coil flavour event (vampsoc.371 - vampsoc.376).

title: The Imperial Scribe
summary: An Imperial Scribe arrives to count the taxes of the province. The Jade Coil has always found scribes delicious.

title: The itch beneath the scales
summary: The old skin grows tight. Bask by the crystal, or ignore it.

title: The crystal hums
summary: A small vision in the Dark Crystal: a lesson, or a hunger.

title: A rival Coil
summary: Another Jade vampire tries to hypnotise your servants. A duel of stares.

title: A crystal shard
summary: A servant brings a sliver of dark crystal found in a mountain stream: perhaps the Shard of the Dark Crystal.

title: The Emperor's hunters
summary: Agents of the Dragon Emperor are hunting the serpents again. Fight them in the dark, or slither away.

title: The Celestial Gaze
summary: The Serpent Sage coils around the greatest of the Dark Crystals and gazes at the whole of the heavens. Three to four years later: vampsoc.381.

title: The heavens seen
summary: The Sage has seen everything under heaven. For life, and every Coil gains Venom.

title: The Beloved
summary: The trial of the Carrion Children: a mortal has asked for you. Love them for a year, and then devour them. A year later: vampsoc.401.

title: The end of love
summary: Devour the Beloved and pass the trial, or spare them and fail it.

title: The Vigil at Gwingui
summary: An Elder of the Swarm keeps vigil at the gate of Gwingui, where the shadow realm touches the world. One to two years later: vampsoc.406.

title: What came through the gate
summary: The vigil ends. The gate has accepted the Elder (the mark of the next Big Bokor) or spat them out.

title: Devouring kin
summary: The Mahtmasi eats another vampire, as the Carrion Children do.

title: A dream sent
summary: The Mahtmasi sends a dream to a mortal ruler. They wake longing, and may come asking; or they wake screaming.

calls: vampsoc.421; vampsoc.422; vampsoc.423; vampsoc.424; vampsoc.425; vampsoc.426
title: Mahtmasi flavour
summary: Picks one Carrion Children flavour event (vampsoc.421 - vampsoc.426).

title: The swarm
summary: You come apart into flies and carrion birds and drift over the land, hearing everything.

title: Fire in the night
summary: The villagers have found your resting place and come with torches. The Mahtmasi fear fire above all.

title: A plea at the altar
summary: A mortal has left an offering at your altar and asks for gold, a child or a dead rival.

title: Maatmeses in dreams
summary: The first of the Mahtmasi, who lives now only in dreams, speaks to you.

title: Running water
summary: Your road crosses a river, and running water burns the Mahtmasi. Go the long way around, or be carried across.

title: The bokor's gift
summary: A bokor brings a fetish from the gate of Gwingui: perhaps the Bokor's Fetish itself.

title: Cast out the Westerlanders
summary: The Big Bokor turns the shadow realm against the Westerlanders of Sudenburg and the witch hunters of Samur. Two to three years later: vampsoc.431.

title: The shadows take Sudenburg
summary: The Westerlanders' hold on Sudenburg is broken. The lands of Sudenburg held by the Big Bokor or their vassals are haunted for good; every Mahtmasi gains Offerings.

title: Another bloodline
summary: A vampire ruler of another bloodline holds lands nearby. The bloodlines have hated each other since Lahmia fell, but a pact can serve both. event_target:vampsoc_other is a vampire ruler of another bloodline.

fired_by: cb_types/cb_types_greenskin.txt; on_action:on_battle_won (random: waaagh_events); on_action:on_battle_won_leader (random: waaagh_events); on_action:on_war_ended_victory; on_action:on_war_started
title: Fightier
summary: One stack of fightiness for a battle or war won (AI rulers get two longer stacks and more prestige).

title: A major victory
summary: Two stacks of fightiness for a major battle won (three for the AI).

title: A lost battle
summary: Fightiness drops by two for a lost battle (the AI may be spared).

title: A major defeat
summary: Fightiness drops by three for a major battle lost (the AI may be spared).

title: A lost war
summary: Fightiness drops by three for a war lost or a white peace (the AI may be spared).

title: Da call grows
summary: A major victory in a WAAAGH! war adds to the call to WAAAGH!.

title: Da call fades
summary: A major defeat in a WAAAGH! war shrinks the call to WAAAGH!.

title: Da boyz want a WAAAGH!
summary: An independent greenskin ruler with fightiness 15 or more is asked to call a WAAAGH!. He can refuse three times (each refusal costs prestige); the fourth time he must call it or become a squatter king. Calling it turns fightiness into WAAAGH! empowerment and starts waaagh.11.

title: WAAAGH!
summary: The ruler takes the WAAAGH! government, gets a WAAAGH! empire title, boyz, manpower and population for his holdings, and two years to start the WAAAGH! war. The AI starts it within a year (waaagh.13).

title: A WAAAGH! is coming
summary: Tells the target and nearby rulers that a WAAAGH! has been declared.

title: WAAAGH!!!
summary: An AI warlord launches his WAAAGH!: more boyz, a large army, prestige and piety.

title: You waited too long
summary: A WAAAGH! government warlord who has not started a WAAAGH! war in time and is no longer fighty enough loses the WAAAGH!: back to tribal government, his king and emperor titles are destroyed, some boyz stay. Players with 1000 prestige can pay to wait longer.

title: The march (every six months)
summary: Runs for the leader of every WAAAGH! war about every six months, from the start of the war until it ends. Wears the warlord out over time, sends a small defender to its fate (waaagh.35), and rolls a march event for every greenskin commander in the defender's lands.

title: Another boss on da march
summary: A player meets another boss of the same WAAAGH! on the march and is asked to his camp for grog and roast squig: make a friend, or show off by krumpin' a few of his boyz.

title: A caravan on da road
summary: The wolf riders spot a merchant caravan near the camp. Raid it for loot, make it pay a toll, send the gobbos in to nick the shiny stuff at night, or let it go. The loot can be a piece of greenskin loot an' plunder or a treasure of the land being raided (waaagh_loot_artifact_effect).

title: A comet
summary: A comet over the camp. Lead the boyz as an omen of Gork, drive them as a taskmaster, or (after both) take advice from a snotling who claims the comet chose him, and make him marshal.

title: Guided by Gork or by grog
summary: The commander claims divine guidance... or was it the drink?

title: A wandering warband
summary: A player meets a greenskin mercenary warband on the march: befriend, insult, hire some of the boyz, or (for great warlords) take them as vassals.

title: Warriors gather
summary: Boyz flock to the WAAAGH!. Reinforcements or manpower, more the fightier the commander.

title: Warriors gather (big)
summary: As waaagh.26, bigger, with a retinue option.

title: Empowered by the WAAAGH!
summary: Fightiness or the call to WAAAGH! turns into WAAAGH! empowerment.

title: Sack the town
summary: A WAAAGH! warlord who takes a holding of the defender can sack it (gold and a chance of loot, buildings burnt, people killed, cruel) or spare it.

title: The WAAAGH! is upon us
summary: A small king or emperor targeted by a WAAAGH! must hold his realm together at a price, or give in: the war ends and his top titles are destroyed.

title: The mighty have fallen
summary: Tells the warlord and the players that a WAAAGH! target gave in.

title: A lieutenant wants land
summary: A landless or low-tier greenskin in a WAAAGH! realm asks the warlord for a county (two or more counties and modest prestige needed). Players can instead leave their demesne unmanaged.

title: Give the lieutenant land?
summary: The warlord gives a county (outside his capital kingdom or duchy if he can, made tribal), or refuses.

title: The WAAAGH! ends
summary: The heir of a dead WAAAGH! warlord who is not strong enough keeps the WAAAGH! only if he is a Black Orc; otherwise the WAAAGH! breaks up.

title: The prestige is shared
summary: Tells the heir and his siblings that the dead warlord's prestige was split.

title: A new war leader
summary: Under military elective succession the heir gets part of the wealth, the artifacts and the titles (the Brass Legion's heir becomes a Chaos champion). Not only greenskins use this.

title: Titles pass on
summary: Gives the dead leader's flagged titles to the heir.

calls: HFP.41090; aiclean.31; beastmen.12; waaagh.61; waaagh.62; waaagh.63
title: Settle the conquered land
summary: A warlord settles a conquered region: give it to a lieutenant, keep it, or migrate the whole horde there.

title: A new greenskin realm
summary: Tells players that a lieutenant now rules the conquered region.

title: The horde migrates
summary: Tells players that a WAAAGH! horde migrated to its conquest.

title: The warlord takes the land
summary: Tells players that a warlord kept the conquered region.

title: Test march events
summary: Debug only: fire from the console to switch off the empty march roll, so every roll gives a march event.

primary_faction: Old World (Empire, Estalia, Tilea, Border Princes)
title: The tribunal sits
summary: An Inquisitor-General tries an accused prisoner: burn, force a recantation, or acquit. Fired by the inquisition_hold_tribunal decision.

primary_faction: Old World (Empire, Estalia, Tilea, Border Princes)
title: The escort rides home
summary: Two years on, the Knights of the Blazing Sun return to their order.

primary_faction: Old World (Empire, Estalia, Tilea, Border Princes)
title: Purged by fire
summary: A Vindicator of Solkan burns the taint out of a province. If a cultist hid at its lord's court, the flames find them. any. Fired by templar_purge_by_fire.

primary_faction: Old World (Empire, Estalia, Tilea, Border Princes)
title: A chapter answers the Border Princes
summary: The chapter a lord of the Border Princes invited sends a hunter. Kislevite lords of Kislev's gods get a Chekist; Myrmidian, Estalian and Tilean lords get the Inquisition; Sigmarite, Ulrican and Taalite lords get the Order of Sigmar three times in four, else a Templar or an Inquisitor; everyone else gets the Templars of Solkan.

title: A hunter at the gate
summary: A wandering witch hunter arrives and offers service, or, if a Templar of Solkan or an Inquisitor, demands residence. Most come from the local chapter; some are Templars or Inquisitors far from home, or hunters of Ulric or Taal. The usual way the rarer hunters reach a court, where they feed the rivalry events (whchapter.10-11). Fired by on_five_year_pulse (random list whchapter_wanderer).

primary_faction: Old World (Empire, Estalia, Tilea, Border Princes)
title: Home from the chapterhouse
summary: Four years after train_court_witch_hunter sent him away, the trainee comes home a witch hunter. He joins the local chapter where one answers for his lord's lands and takes the court seat if one is free.

primary_faction: Old World (Empire, Estalia, Tilea, Border Princes)
title: The trainee returns
summary: The lord learns that his courtier is back from the chapterhouse.

primary_faction: Old World (Empire, Estalia, Tilea, Border Princes)
title: Chapter marks
summary: Members of the Inquisition or the Templars of Solkan who joined some other way (the society screen, startup) take the chapter's trait and culture.

primary_faction: Old World (Empire, Estalia, Tilea, Border Princes)
title: A question of jurisdiction
summary: A hunter of another chapter at the same court claims the right to a case. Defer, stand firm, or put it to the lord. Fired by on_five_year_pulse (random list whchapter_rivalry).

primary_faction: Old World (Empire, Estalia, Tilea, Border Princes)
title: A Templar denounces a lax hunter
summary: A Templar of Solkan finds a hunter of another chapter soft, drunk or worse. Fired by on_five_year_pulse (random list whchapter_rivalry).

title: The wolf-hunters of Ulric
summary: Grey-cloaked hunters of Ulric track a beast-witch onto the ruler's lands.

title: The wardens of Taal
summary: Taal's wardens hunt a witch who poisoned a sacred grove.

title: The Seekers of Truth and Justice
summary: A Seeker of Verena asks to examine an accused prisoner before sentence. Fired by on_decade_pulse (whchapter_other_hunters).

title: The Ordo Fidelis
summary: The secret order that watches the witch hunters comes for the ruler's court witch hunter, whose methods have gone too far. Fired by on_decade_pulse (whchapter_other_hunters).

primary_faction: Old World (Empire, Estalia, Tilea, Border Princes)
title: The Lord of Vengeance
summary: A zealous or wrathful Templar of Solkan, not yet of his faith, is drawn to the cult itself. Only non-rulers, so the faith stays small.

title: A province bears the taint of Chaos
summary: A ruler with a Chaos-tainted demesne province (Nurgle disease, beastmen, warpdust, warpstone, Slaanesh hedonism) decides whether to send their court witch hunter after it. Cultist rulers may refuse.

title: Evil stirs
summary: The witch hunter receives the call for help and sets out. Province events that fire this save the ruler as event_target:whunter_client.

title: The witch hunter arrives
summary: The ruler welcomes the witch hunter to court.

title: Time to get to work
summary: The witch hunter starts a three-year hunt at the ruler's court and moves there unless they already hold a court witch hunter title.

title: The investigation is finished
summary: After three years the hunt ends. The witch hunter gains skill, tells the liege, and goes home.

title: The witch hunter reports
summary: The witch hunter reports to the ruler; the purge marker leaves the province.

title: A suspicious courtier
summary: A witch hunter on a hunt picks a suspicious-looking courtier of their liege (mutated, ugly, lustful, mystic...) and confronts them. list).

title: Hunting suspected cultists
summary: A witch hunter on a hunt goes after a courtier of their liege who is under suspicion, highly suspect or a known satanist. The confrontation goes on as for whunter.10 (whunter.12).

title: The courtier is confronted
summary: The accused courtier answers the witch hunter. Their Intrigue and Learning, known suspicion, and magic laws for mages decide whether the hunter believes them. Reached from whunter.10 and 11; the investigation (whunter.176) also uses it to confront unlanded suspects.

title: Not a heretic
summary: The witch hunter is convinced the courtier is innocent, but may still accuse.

title: A heretic
summary: The witch hunter is convinced the courtier is a heretic and accuses them.

title: The accused appeals
summary: The accused courtier hears the charge. An independent ruler deals with the witch hunter directly; anyone else appeals to their liege.

title: The liege decides
summary: The liege chooses: burn the accused, imprison them, or spare them. When the accusation is upheld the hunter gains piety, may learn from the case, and Order members earn currency; mission hunters are paid or fined by the Order depending on the verdict. Also the verdict for hunt quarries (whunter.192).

title: Burned at the stake
summary: The accused is burned. Shared verdict: also fired by the mage hunt (whunter.152) and by Chaos and mutation events.

title: Imprisoned
summary: The liege imprisons the accused. Shared verdict, as whunter.17.

title: Spared
summary: The liege intervenes and the witch hunter backs off. Shared verdict, as whunter.17.

title: A noble burned
summary: Players in the realm hear that a landed noble was burned by the witch hunters. They can choose not to hear about it again.

title: Cleansing the taint
summary: A court witch hunter on a hunt removes the Chaos taint from one of the liege's provinces.

title: The taint is gone
summary: The liege hears the taint has been removed; the taint modifiers leave one tainted province.

title: Vampires in the realm
summary: An idle witch hunter warns the top liege that vampires walk openly in the realm, unless the liege allows vampires. (whunter_realm_heretics list).

title: The hunters come for the vampires
summary: The top liege calls the hunt. Strong vampires (Martial or Intrigue 15) escape once; the others are burned.

title: A vampire escapes
summary: The vampire flees the realm and remembers the lucky escape.
